title.purpose: Borehole or project name in the work area.

drawing.purpose: Ticks and labels on logs and charts, in the export fonts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #245b78; border-radius: 3px; background: #245b78; color: #fff; font: 500 13px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1b4760; border-color: #1b4760; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #245b78; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #b9c0c9; border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; color: #1f2937; font: 400 13px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #e8eff3; border-color: #8f99a5; } .ds-btn:active { background: #dbe7ee; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #245b78; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-fld { display: grid; gap: 3px; font: 600 12px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; color: #576272; } .ds-input { height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #949eaa; border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; color: #1f2937; font: 13px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #6f7a87; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: #245b78; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(36,91,120,.22); }

components.name: Tree Item
components.description: Project tree row; selected takes the selected fill.
components.css: .ds-tree { display: grid; width: 220px; } .ds-nv { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: none; text-align: left; font: 13px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; color: #1f2937; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nv:hover { background: #e8eff3; } .ds-nv[aria-current="page"] { background: #dbe7ee; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Draft, For review, Issued: square, tinted, worded.
components.html: Draft For review Issued
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 3px; font: 600 11px/18px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-draft { color: #6b5508; background: #fbf3d6; border-color: #ecd98f; } .ds-review { color: #8a3d0a; background: #fcebdd; border-color: #f0c39d; } .ds-issued { color: #1c5a37; background: #e1f2e7; border-color: #a9d8b9; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Square white panel with a raised header band.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid #d5d9df; background: #fff; width: 320px; font: 13px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; color: #1f2937; } .ds-panel header { height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; background: #f7f8fa; border-bottom: 1px solid #d5d9df; font-weight: 600; } .ds-body { padding: 12px; }

components.name: Status Bar
components.description: Always-on save state, borehole and problems.
components.html: Saved on this computerBorehole BH24-02 · DraftNo problems found
components.css: .ds-sb { display: flex; height: 24px; background: #eceef1; border-top: 1px solid #d5d9df; font: 12px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; color: #576272; } .ds-sb span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 10px; border-right: 1px solid #d5d9df; } .ds-sb b { color: #1f2937; } .ds-ok { color: #1f2937; } .ds-ok::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #287a52; }

narrative.overview: A conventional engineering desktop workspace: menu bar, toolbar, project tree, work area and an always-on status bar. Colour does a job or stays out: cool grey and white chrome, one slate-teal for action, selection and focus, and soil, water and status hues only on data.
keyCharacteristics: Cool grey ground, white panels, 1px rules, no resting shadows.
One slate-teal for action, selection and focus.
Square panels and tables, 3px controls, 4px menus, 5px dialogs.
The system UI font at 13px for everything on screen; drawings in the export fonts.
Compact office density (28px toolbar buttons, 30px inputs and rows); field mode and Quick Log keep 44–56px targets.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Slate teal appears only on the primary action, selection and focus; a second filled primary in the same view is a defect.

rules.name: The Data-Only Hue Rule
rules.body: Soil, water and status colours live on data and status tags, never on chrome.

rules.name: The Preview Is the PDF Rule
rules.body: Drawings on screen use the export's fonts; never restyle a drawing in the UI face.

rules.name: The No Resting Shadow Rule
rules.body: Anything that sits in the layout is drawn with a border, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep ground and surface the only two grounds, with raised for headers.
Do give each view one filled primary action.
Do report save state and problems in the status bar, in words.
Do keep field mode and Quick Log targets at 44px or more.
donts: Don't use pills, gradients, glows, glass or resting shadows.
Don't nest panels or round panels and tables.
Don't draw icons with text characters; draw them as SVG.
Don't restyle log drawings in the UI font.
Don't add a dark theme; light only.
